## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: extremely weak sector breadth (only Energy positive) and narrow leadership in top performers (Leadership: Narrow — 4/5 Technology), with major divergence among megacaps (≥3 large names showing 1W vs 1M mismatch) supporting a neutral stance.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +18.23%) ABOVE TREND. Technology shows pockets of strength: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials have short-term bounces: ETN (1W: +7.11% | 1M: -7.52%) RECOVERY, CAT (1W: +2.30% | 1M: -4.33%) RECOVERY.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Healthcare worst weekly draw: SYK (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -20.64%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND, NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: SBUX (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -10.65% | 1M: -17.86%) BELOW TREND. Materials and Communication under pressure on the week as well.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND; QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND; ETN (1W: +7.11% | 1M: -7.52%) RECOVERY; META (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology), style: mixed / no clear leadership given weak sector breadth.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -6.60% | 1M: -3.93%) BELOW TREND; SBUX (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND; PLTR (1W: -8.38% | 1M: -2.23%) BELOW TREND; NOW (1W: -8.97% | 1M: +6.07%) CORRECTION; SYK (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -20.64%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in cyclical healthcare and high-multiple tech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: AMD (1W: +13.15%), INTC (1W: +12.29%), QCOM (1W: +7.95%), ETN (1W: +7.11%), META (1W: +6.12%) — all showing strong short-term rotation into select names. Note major divergence: MSFT (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +0.84%) CORRECTION, TSLA (1W: -2.90% | 1M: +11.58%) CORRECTION and other trend-exhaustion names signal tactical uncertainty.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed — high dispersion with clear leaders but overall sector down on the week (Tech 1W: -0.21% across 24 stocks). AAPL (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +9.93%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND contrast with NVDA (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -2.48%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -1.10% | 1M: -1.40%) BELOW TREND; sector internals are rotating.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Soft to neutral: JPM (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -2.45%) BELOW TREND while payment names show short-term pullbacks — V (1W: -2.19% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +1.69%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W: -1.78% with mixed leadership and limited breadth support.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Under pressure: UNH (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -3.79% | 1M: -8.44%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -4.62% | 1M: +2.31%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W: -5.60% with several large-cap weaknesses confirming downside momentum.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Given NEUTRAL regime and narrow leadership, favor selective exposure to Energy (XOM, CVX, VLO) and high-conviction Tech leaders (AMD, QCOM) while reducing exposure to lagging healthcare and discretionary names showing confirmed BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; prioritize position selection and monitor megacap divergences for regime confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +18.23%) ABOVE TREND — watch whether momentum broadens. BEARISH: NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -2.52%) BELOW TREND — earnings/sentiment to monitor.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (only sector positive; XOM/CVX/VLO ABOVE TREND) — watch commodity cues. BEARISH: Healthcare (sector weakest, breadth poor) and Consumer Discretionary (notable downside in BKNG/SBUX) — watch earnings and sentiment flow.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA for continued re-acceleration vs its 1M downtrend as a trigger for broader tech risk-on; monitor AMD/INTC 1W momentum holding to confirm narrow leadership. Track XOM/CVX 1M strength to validate sector-level carry; a widening of positive sector breadth above 3-4 sectors would shift regime bias from neutral.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
D (1W: n/a | 1M: n/a) (+85): NextEra-Dominion merger headlines — cross-ref with price: utilities sentiment strong but sector-level confirmation limited; watch actual price action. JNJ (1W: -4.62% | 1M: +2.31%) CORRECTION (+75): Apollo orthopedics talks — sentiment bullish but price down on week (diverging). ORCL (1W: n/a | 1M: n/a) (+60): $30B AI contracts headline — sentiment positive; cross-ref: ORCL showing news-led interest versus mixed broader tech internals (partial confirmation).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND (-50): deal-trouble headlines and price collapsing — sentiment confirmed. FCX (1W: n/a | 1M: n/a) (-50): tariff doubts on copper — watch materials flow; price reaction in sector confirms risk-off for miners. ADBE (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -2.52%) BELOW TREND (-45): analyst cut on AI monetization concerns — sentiment confirms stock weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. AMD, INTC and Energy names (XOM, CVX, VLO) showing relative strength (AMD/INTC ABOVE TREND; XOM/CVX/VLO ABOVE TREND). Key risk: narrow, tech-heavy leadership with major megacap divergences and mixed sentiment (JNJ/ORCL headlines diverging from price) — monitor for broader breadth pickup before increasing exposure.
